about: The Epistle of the formulary “21st Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: Be strengthened in the Lord and in the might of His power. Put on God’s armor, so that you can stand against the devil’s snares. For we do not wrestle against flesh and blood, but against the princes and the powers, against the rulers of this world of darkness, against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavens. For this reason take up God’s armor, so that you can resist on the evil day, and stand complete in all things. So stand, having your loins girded with truth, and wearing the breastplate of justice, and having your feet shod with the readiness of the gospel of peace; in everything taking the shield of faith, by which you can extinguish all the fiery missiles of the most wicked one. And put on the helmet of salvation, and take the sword of the Spirit, that is, the word of God.
